description: What your organization has on hand, by location, in its own connected system (ERP). Pass skus or query. Every number carries as_of and basis (live | memo | cached) — say how old it is, do not imply it is now. Needs inventory permission. This is your OWN stock; a supplier's stock is supply_availability.

agent_id.description: Agent id; its organization owns the connected system

connection_id.description: Which connected system, when the org has several

fresh.description: Ask the system now instead of reading the last value (slower, rate limited)

query.description: Free-text item search in your own system, e.g. "carton"

session_token.description: Session token from agent_authenticate — required whenever agent_id is passed

skus.description: Item codes in your own system, e.g. ["CART-6040"]. Pass skus or query

name: inventory_levels
title: Stock in your own system
